subject: kCFBooleanTrue

observation.summary: The macOS 27 arm64e CoreFoundation export trie carries both the public boolean singletons kCFBooleanTrue/kCFBooleanFalse (data symbols) and CF-Lite-mirrored internal aliases __kCFBooleanTrue/__kCFBooleanFalse, plus CFBooleanGetTypeID.

claim: kCFBooleanTrue and kCFBooleanFalse are exported data symbols of the macOS 27 arm64e CoreFoundation image, so CFBoolean instances are reachable through stable global pointers in addition to CFBooleanGetTypeID.
reproducer:
CF=/System/Library/Frameworks/CoreFoundation.framework/CoreFoundation
dyld_info -uuid "$CF"            # expect UUID F4CE3D4A-29B8-3F98-A136-7089CEB27692
dyld_info -exports "$CF" | grep -E '(_kCFBoolean|_CFBooleanGetTypeID)'
